recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for this issue unless the Security or Terminology work groups make a new decision about canonical identifier policy or resolvability guarantees.
issue_request: FHIR-20555 was a Published/Persuasive Security work group issue for STU3 All Security Labels. It reported that value set systems were shown as URLs that did not resolve and requested correct URLs, code system names, or OIDs.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-20555 was found. Jira comments explained that the reported values are terminology URIs rather than guaranteed-resolvable URLs, and the final Jira resolution says there is nothing to fix.
additional_context: The current All Security Labels value set has its canonical FHIR URL, OID identifier metadata, and THO value set imports by canonical URI. General Coding.system, CodeSystem.url, and ValueSet.url guidance explains that these are URI/canonical identifiers and that resolvability is preferred but not always possible. Security Labels is in the current Security and Privacy page tree and Meta.security binds to All Security Labels.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Changing canonical terminology URIs to names or OIDs would conflict with current Coding.system guidance, and adding local explanatory prose would duplicate existing terminology guidance without changing implementer understanding.
